categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes proxy connection formatting in src/netbase.cpp for SOCKS5/Tor proxy connections to peers.
categories.rationale: Fixes outbound connection drops to 20–29% of IPv6 peers when routing through Tor SOCKS5 proxies. Due to an upstream Tor parsing issue with compressed IPv6 destinations and appended ports, outbound connections fail with a closed 'general failure' and no fallback.
